name: superbot
description: superbot is an agent manager app that manages the AI apps you already pay for. This plugin adds its one MCP tool, superbot, and a skill that shows Codex how to use it.

interface.shortDescription: An agent manager for the AI apps you already pay for
interface.longDescription: superbot is an agent manager app: a desktop app that manages the AI apps you already pay for, without wrapping or replacing them. This plugin connects Codex to its one MCP tool, superbot, which takes a request in plain words and hands back a finished result.
defaultPrompt: Use superbot to search the web for current information on a topic I name.
Ask superbot what it can do for a task I describe.
